digest.component_or_area: BindingStore persistence and rotation state management
propositions: After a successful new-writer save, the inline last_get_pass field must be absent from all entries in bindings.json while preserving rotation state in get_rotation.json
The save operation must atomically persist get_rotation.json before scrubbing and writing bindings.json, ensuring the chronological maximum rotation value is durable even if the bindings write fails
When sidecar persistence fails, the primary binding save must succeed with the latest inline last_get_pass retained as a failure-floor, allowing later retries to converge to sidecar-only state
Mixed old-writer and new-writer sequences must correctly migrate any later inline rotation timestamp into get_rotation.json and converge to a consistent state with no duplicate or lost rotation data
